newsitem.title: USA: Skysat says Nasdaq denies listing request.
newsitem.headline: Skysat says Nasdaq denies listing request.

text.p: Skysat Communications Network Corp said on Friday the Nasdaq Stock Market has denied its request for continued temporary listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap market.
As of April 1, 1997, the company's securities could be traded on the NASDAQ OTC Bulletin Board, Skysat said.
Skysat said it is in the process of preparing to file a motion for reconsideration.
Skysat said it has entered into an agreement with Av-Intel Inc.
Skysat believes that Av-Intel's airship technology will make Skysat a leader in wireless communications with airships that would operate from geosynchronous locations 70,000 foot altitudes, it said.
Skysat and Av-Intel plan to produce a pre-production airship and move into commercial production during 1997.
